detail: East-facing three-story L plan of 1,395 square metres, central entrance, stone former basement excavated in 1936, sheet-metal roofs above timber structure.
Two-story New Building northwest of the main wing, 503 square metres, clapboards, hipped-gabled sheet-metal roof, cornices and ornamental balustrade.
Three-story Annex northeast of the Main Building, with layered copper gables, around 423 square metres and a southeast karahafu porch.
Hotel chronology dates the Main to 1893, the stone ground floor to 1936 and the five-story Second New Building to 1961.
The hotel conservation account identifies the Annex roof finish as copper.
